rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive vulnerability intelligence through the Exploit Intelligence Platform, covering over 350,000 CVEs and 115,000 proof-of-concept exploits. Supports searching vulnerabilities by keyword, CVE ID, severity, and product, with enriched data including CVSS scores, exploit availability, and threat actor associations. Available both as a local PyPI package and through a cloud-hosted streamable HTTP endpoint.
